requirements.description: Annual Compustat firm-year inputs used for sample filters, book/market controls, fiscal-year alignment and directly named financial statement measures.

required_coverage.population: U.S. Compustat Industrial and Research firm-years in the 1988–1997 study period, with prior-year denominator fields and year-ahead outcomes.
required_coverage.detail: The sample starts in 1988; average-assets scaling requires t−1 values and the matched forecast fit uses Earn(t+1) through 1998. Helper window check: anchor 1987–1998; lookback 0 months, lead 0 months gives conservative envelope 1987–1998.

routes.mapping_notes: Catalog labels support the directly named annual Compustat identifiers, assets, sales, equity, shares, fiscal-year-end price and dividends used for sample restrictions and market/book controls. The article’s numeric Compustat item numbers are handled in a separate unresolved mapping requirement.
routes.coverage_notes: An exact-resource probe supports bounded readability and the listed live columns. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this study period and target population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation supports this local snapshot for the required historical population; route completeness therefore remains undetermined.

requirements.description: Historical Compustat item #123 earnings and #308 operating cash flows (plus the paper’s #124 cash-flow adjustment in one equation passage) and related annual scaling inputs used in persistence, forecasting and pricing fits.

required_coverage.population: Firm-years underlying the full and HIO/LIO matched samples; include prior-year assets and one-year-ahead earnings through 1998.
required_coverage.detail: Coverage envelope 1987–1998 includes t−1 average-assets denominators and the t+1 outcome at the 1997 endpoint. Current Compustat field names are not accepted as semantic mappings for the historical numeric item identifiers. Helper window check: anchor 1987–1998; lookback 0 months, lead 0 months gives conservative envelope 1987–1998.

routes.mapping_notes: The exact live fields are present, but the article cites historical Compustat items #123 (and in the text, #124) and #308. Do not infer correspondence from the modern field names; the #308 versus #308−#124 cash-flow formula also varies across the paper.
routes.coverage_notes: An exact-resource probe supports bounded readability and the listed live columns. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this study period and target population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: A bounded probe confirms the selected current Compustat fields, but exact mapping of item #123/#308/#124 to the current vintage and the paper’s #308 versus #308−#124 definitions remain unresolved.

requirements.description: Firm-specific annual time-series inputs for the persistence coefficient used to match LIO/HIO firms: Earn_t, Accruals_{t−1}, and CashFlows_{t−1}. The length/start of each firm-specific regression window is not reported.

required_coverage.population: Study firms in sample years through 1997; include each firm’s entire source-used history for the selection regression.
required_coverage.detail: The within-fit predictor lag is one year, but the number of years in each firm-specific time series is not given; preserve an unbounded raw beginning. Helper window check: anchor None–1997; lookback 0 months, lead 0 months gives conservative envelope None–1997.

routes.mapping_notes: The exact live fields are present, but the article cites historical Compustat items #123/#308 and lagged persistence inputs. Do not infer a current-field crosswalk or the persistence regression start from field names.
routes.coverage_notes: An exact-resource probe supports bounded readability and the listed live columns. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this study period and target population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The paper identifies the lagged annual inputs but does not report the persistence-regression history window; exact raw start remains unknown and local coverage is unconfirmed.

requirements.description: Quarterly CDA Spectrum 13F holdings used to calculate annual institutional ownership, classify LIO/HIO firm-years, and determine the transient-ownership minimum.

required_coverage.frequency: quarterly institution-security holdings and report dates
required_coverage.population: U.S. common-stock positions reported on 13F in the paper’s Compustat/CRSP sample; the no-file and zero-ownership cases are necessary for LIO classification.
required_coverage.detail: The paper uses annual average institutional holdings and requires a top-third annual ranking plus at least 5% transient ownership for HIO; missing/no report cases must be distinguished from zero ownership. Helper window check: anchor 1988–1997; lookback 0 months, lead 0 months gives conservative envelope 1988–1997.

routes.mapping_notes: The table has exact holdings/report-date/CUSIP and shares fields. Unit scaling, quarterly averaging, CUSIP transitions, and no-file/zero-ownership treatment remain to be confirmed for the historical 13F population.
routes.coverage_notes: An exact-resource probe supports bounded readability and the listed live columns. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this study period and target population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Exact fields are readable, but full report-date, CUSIP, holdings and investor-population coverage for 1988–1997 is not confirmed.

requirements.description: Bushee (1998) institutional manager type classifications (transient, dedicated and quasi-indexer) needed to calculate transient ownership and the HIO threshold.

required_coverage.population: Managers in the CDA Spectrum institutional holdings population in the 1988–1997 sample.
required_coverage.detail: The paper ends the sample in 1997 because that is the last year for the Bushee (1998) institutional classifications; classifications must map manager IDs to the reported type in each year. Helper window check: anchor 1988–1997; lookback 0 months, lead 0 months gives conservative envelope 1988–1997.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No verified local or public raw route for the Bushee manager-year classifications was established in the allowed catalog and evidence checks.

requirements.description: Monthly CRSP total security returns used to construct one-year size-adjusted buy-and-hold returns after the annual report and market value/size rankings.

required_coverage.frequency: monthly security returns and month-end prices/shares
required_coverage.population: NYSE, AMEX and NASDAQ common stocks in the study sample and the size-decile benchmark universe.
required_coverage.detail: The abnormal-return holding period begins in the fourth month after fiscal year end and lasts one year; the 1997 sample endpoint can require CRSP returns into calendar 1999 depending on fiscal year-end. Helper window check: anchor 1988–1999; lookback 0 months, lead 0 months gives conservative envelope 1988–1999.

routes.mapping_notes: Catalog fields identify monthly total returns, prices and shares. Compound firm buy-and-hold returns over the paper’s period; formation timing and eligible size-decile benchmark universe are separate unresolved requirements.

routes.mapping_notes: Raw security returns and size inputs are present; the paper’s same-size-decile benchmark population and formation rule are not fully specified.

requirements.description: Date-effective mapping between CDA Spectrum CUSIPs, CRSP securities and Compustat firms for annual holdings, return, and firm-year joins.

required_coverage.detail: Use CRSP name history for CUSIP/NCUSIP-to-PERMNO and CCM for GVKEY-to-PERMNO; preserve validity dates and security class restrictions. Helper window check: anchor 1988–1999; lookback 0 months, lead 0 months gives conservative envelope 1988–1999.

routes.mapping_notes: Historical name records expose dated CUSIP/NCUSIP to PERMNO fields. The relationship to each CDA report-date CUSIP and Compustat CUSIP still needs date-valid linkage and coverage confirmation.

variable_coverage.construction: Earn_t: Net income before extraordinary items (Compustat item #123), scaled by average total assets. Reported formula: Compustat #123 / average total assets. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Accruals_{t-1}: Lagged Accruals, where Accruals = Earn − CashFlows; for the matching fits the inputs are lagged one year. Reported formula: Accruals_{t-1} = Earn_{t-1} − CashFlows_{t-1}. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

CashFlows_{t-1}: Lagged net cash flow from operating activities (Compustat item #308), scaled by average total assets. Reported formula: CashFlows_{t-1} = Compustat #308 / average total assets. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Earn_{t+1}: Net income before extraordinary items (Compustat item #123), scaled by average total assets. Reported formula: Compustat #123 / average total assets. Accruals_t: Earn_t minus CashFlows_t; Earn is net income before extraordinary items (Compustat #123) scaled by average total assets, and CashFlows is net cash flow from operating activities (Compustat #308) scaled by average total assets. Reported formula: Earn_t − CashFlows_t. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

H_Accruals_t: The interaction of the HIO indicator H with Accruals_t. H equals one for HIO and zero for LIO; HIO firm-years are ranked in the top third of yearly institutional holdings and must have at least 5% transient institutional holdings, while LIO firm-years are absent from 13-F filings or have zero institutional ownership. Reported formula: H × Accruals_t. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Join annual Compustat, CRSP return/size series, CDA CUSIP holdings and Bushee manager classifications with date-valid identifiers.
The selected Mishkin-equation baselines report no fixed-effect dummy family; no extra FE data are identified.
No standard-error cluster correction is specified for the selected Mishkin system; none is inferred.
No regression weights are reported; firm-level asset scaling is part of input construction, not a regression weight.
The paper estimates the two Mishkin equations simultaneously with generalized nonlinear least squares. The support persistence regression’s exact estimator/window is not named.

Retain the paper’s sample thresholds, full-sample top-third annual institutional holdings ranking, at least 5% transient holdings for HIO, LIO no filing or zero ownership, and ±0.03 accrual-persistence matching.
